TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A close-up photograph of a red fire alarm pull station mounted on a white interior wall. The box-shaped device has white diagonal stripes along its edges, a recessed pull slot at the top, and raised white lettering on its front face. The background is a blurred indoor corridor with warm wooden and golden tones at left, keeping the alarm in sharp focus.
TEXT: PULL IN CASE OF FIRE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A macro photograph of a United States banknote focused on the black circular Federal Reserve System seal, which depicts an eagle with spread wings above a shield of vertical stripes surrounded by the seal's ring lettering. The surrounding paper is white with scattered orange-yellow security numerals repeated across the surface, and small star and spiral guilloche motifs are visible at the edges. A line of small microprint text runs along the lower left but is too blurred to read.
TEXT: UNITED STATES FEDERAL RESERVE SYSTEM, 05, 05, 05, 05, 05, 05, 05, 05, 05, 05, 05, 05, 05
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: An editorial political cartoon against a blue sky with a large full moon. On the right, a bearded man in a black clerical turban and robe stands at the arched balcony of a dark domed tower labeled IRAN, arms outstretched as he releases a swarm of cartoon bats. The bats fly leftward across the moon, several of them straddling or riding missiles and bombs of various sizes and colors, including a red-tipped rocket and a green bomb. A speech bubble from the man fills the upper left.
TEXT: FLY, MY PROXIES. FLY!!
IRAN
Lisa ©2023 10:30 Counterpoint Media
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A white rectangular paper note pinned to a brown corkboard with two round orange-red push pins, one at the upper left corner and one at the upper right. On the note, a question is handwritten in large black marker capitals across two lines. The corkboard texture fills the rest of the frame with soft lighting.
TEXT: WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR?
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A low-angle photograph of traffic signals silhouetted against a pale blue twilight sky. The pedestrian signal glows with the green walking-figure aspect (the East German Ampelmann style hatted figure), while an adjacent vehicle signal head shows its red lamp illuminated and its other lamps dark. Below, dark cylindrical signal housings and a speaker unit are visible in silhouette, with a small white marking on the pole at lower left.
TEXT: K3
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A worm's-eye-view photograph looking straight up between four glass-and-steel skyscrapers whose facades converge toward a clear, cloudless blue sky. The curtain-wall grids create strong converging diagonal lines, and low warm sunlight from the left gilds the edges and mullions of the nearest towers while the right tower remains in cool shadow. A few lit windows are visible on the lower building faces.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

A dark, low horizon line runs along the bottom edge of the frame below the hourglass.
